title: Revise Table 2.2 rows and component column
requirements:
- Reconcile Table 2.2 (LIMR as a later enabler) with 4.3.1 and the architecture-placement guidance
- State that governance, quality and audit are architecture-wide responsibilities
- Rename the column to cover cross-cutting capabilities as well as components
- Distinguish a governed minimum information model, required at every starting point, from LIMR tooling built progressively
- Explain how they are realised through component-level stewardship, reconciling 2.1's cross-cutting framing with component requirements
- List the exchange services, gateways and trust services through which interoperability is realised
